posts.cooked:
I posted this on BGG, but thought I might get a quicker, more accurate reponse here.

 

Ok so I was trying this out solo, playing two Strike force ships (Vigilance, Ranak Warbeast).

Let me see if I can describe what happened. The start of the game I placed the opp. ships 1-2-1 (Technovore). My forces attacked and destroyed the opp ship in the right sector. During Aftermath a mission card had an Aftermath event that brought out an opp. ship to the center (now totally 3). This now caused the sector to be overrun(we had to flip 3 station cards. My understanding is that since the ship came out during the aftermath event phase it is considered unengaged so we merit a station card flip (this i may have got wrong). This triggered the Technovore Flagship to enter play. 

As the next round began a travel event in the sector with the flagship instructed me to move the ship with the most [E] to the sector with the fewest ships, so with 2 opp. ships in one sector and my two strike force ships in the either .. we chose to move the flagship into our sector.

Through some great cards I was able to install tech and use boosts to get Vigilance attack to sixteen .. more than enough to wipe out the Hive Master ... 

we easily won on round 2 ... did I miss something?

posts.cooked:
The Hive Master would come out with 6 weaponry and 8 defense.

16 weaponry would deal 8 energy damage to it (16 - 8 = 8), which would reduce it to 6 weaponry and 0 defense. It would not be destroyed. Though you would most likely have won on the next turn.

posts.cooked:
revvbard:

Ok I'm missing an important rule here … 16 weapon only does 8 damage? why is this halved? I've totally missed this … please explain!

Damage Dealt = Your Weaponry - Their Shields

16W (vigi) - 8D (Hive) = 8 Energy Damage dealt. (Hive would deal you damage in the same way simultaneously)

You always remove energy from shields first. Since Hive started at 6W/8D, it would end with 6W/0D

Does that help?
